summary: Navigator Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its subsidiary Navigator Gas L.L.C. entered into a $164.64 million secured pre-delivery term loan (Bridge Facility) with BNP Paribas to finance up to 80% of pre-delivery installments for two newbuild gas carriers under construction at Jiangnan Shipyard. The Bridge Facility will convert into a $205.8 million JOLCO sale-leaseback upon delivery in 2027, covering the full purchase price. The vessels will be bareboat chartered back with purchase options after 8.5 years. No price per share, premium, or shareholder vote involved. The filing is a routine financing arrangement not constituting a special situation event.
